mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte imbalances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may impair ethosuximide metabolism and increase seizure risk through lowered seizure threshold.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and seizure control closely; maintain adequate hydration and consider alternative antifungal if possible; adjust ethosuximide dosing based on renal function.
